observations: A large blue industrial mixing machine with a rectangular hopper and a cylindrical mixing chamber.
The machine is mounted on a blue steel frame with four legs.
A motor is visible on the left side, connected to the mixing chamber via a drive shaft.
The front of the machine has a circular access door with a handle and a bolted seal.
The machine is painted bright blue, with some paint drips and uneven coating visible.
The setting appears to be an open workshop or yard with corrugated metal roofing and scattered tools and materials.
No brand name or model is visible on the machine in either photo.
The seller claims to custom build machines for paints, ribbon, pastes, powder, and other industrial uses.
